data.desc: Cannae is a diversified holding company that provides shareholders a unique opportunity to generate returns through owning a portfolio of operating businesses. The Company is transitioning its portfolio to focus on sports and entertainment-related assets, with the goal of building a more concentrated and synergistic portfolio designed to generate long-term investment returns and stock price appreciation for shareholders. We believe Cannae's permanent capital base, long-term ownership and active involvement in the management and operations of our companies help maximize the value of those businesses for our shareholders. Cannae primarily acquires interests in operating companies and is actively engaged in managing and operating a core group of those companies.
